schemes.title: Andaman & Nicobar e-District Certificates
schemes.department: Administration of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands
schemes.brief: The islands' single window for the certificates a resident needs — income, local certificate, SC and ST certificates, birth and death registration and residence proof. Applying online saves a boat trip, which matters when your tehsil office is on another island.
schemes.benefit: Digitally signed income, local, tribe and residence certificates without travelling to the tehsil
eligibility: Resident of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, applying in the tehsil where you live
A local certificate needs proof that the family has lived in the islands for the qualifying period
A Scheduled Tribe certificate is issued only for the notified tribes of the islands
An income certificate is valid for one year; a tribe certificate does not expire
documents: Residence proof — electricity bill, rent agreement or a Panchayat certificate
Birth certificate or school certificate for date of birth
Salary certificate or an affidavit of income, for an income certificate

demoFields.label: Certificate applied for
demoFields.hint: Income, local, SC, ST, residence, birth or death. Each opens its own form and asks for different proof.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The certificate prints from this entry.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: Used to identify the family in the tehsil records.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Identity is confirmed on this and the OTP goes to the linked mobile.

demoFields.label: District / Tehsil / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where you actually live. The Tehsildar of this tehsil signs the certificate.

demoFields.label: Years the family has lived in the islands
demoFields.hint: For a local certificate, say from when. The ration card, school records or an old electricity bill are what prove it.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: For an income certificate, the household's total for the year from every source.

demoFields.label: Purpose
demoFields.hint: Say plainly what it is for. It is recorded but does not restrict where the certificate is used.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the ready message come here by SMS.

demoSteps: Register on edistrict.andamannicobar.gov.in with your mobile and confirm the OTP, or use a Common Service Centre on your island.
Choose the certificate you need and fill the form from your Aadhaar and ration card.
Upload Aadhaar, the ration card, the residence proof and the income or tribe proof, then submit and note the application number.
The Patwari or the tehsil staff verify the family. Be reachable on the mobile you gave, since an island visit may be replaced by a phone check.
The Tehsildar signs the certificate digitally and it is downloaded from the same login. A digitally signed copy needs no attestation.
If it is delayed beyond the time the service promises, quote the application number to the tehsil office or the Deputy Commissioner's office.
schemes.helpline: Your Tehsildar's office, or the Deputy Commissioner's office at Port Blair

schemes.title: Andaman & Nicobar eServices — Bills, Permits and Payments
schemes.department: Administration of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands
schemes.brief: The islands' online counter for the things residents pay and apply for regularly — electricity and water bills, licences, permits and departmental fees — without a trip to the office. Useful anywhere, essential when the office is a ferry ride away.
schemes.benefit: Electricity, water and departmental payments and applications made from home
eligibility: Resident or consumer in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands
A consumer number for the service you are paying for, as printed on the bill
A mobile number for the OTP and the payment receipt
Any card, net banking or UPI account for the payment
documents: Latest bill showing the consumer number
Aadhaar card, for an application rather than a payment
Mobile number to receive the receipt

demoFields.label: Service wanted
demoFields.hint: Electricity, water, licence fee, permit or a departmental payment. Pick the department first, then the service.

demoFields.label: Consumer Number
demoFields.hint: Printed at the top of your bill. Copy it exactly — a wrong digit pays somebody else's bill and getting it back is slow.

demoFields.label: Consumer Name
demoFields.hint: As printed on the bill, which may differ from Aadhaar. The portal shows the name after you enter the consumer number — check it before paying.

demoFields.label: Billing period / Bill number
demoFields.hint: From the bill in your hand. Paying against the wrong bill number leaves the current one unpaid.

demoFields.label: Amount payable (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: The portal fills this from the department's record. If it differs from your paper bill, pay what the portal shows and take the paper bill to the office.

demoFields.label: Address of the premises
demoFields.hint: Needed for a new connection or a name change, not for an ordinary payment.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The payment receipt and the transaction reference come here by SMS. Keep it until the next bill shows the payment.

demoFields.label: Payment method
demoFields.hint: Card, net banking or UPI. Do not close the browser until the receipt appears, even if the money has left your account.

demoSteps: Open eservices.andamannicobar.gov.in and choose the department and the service you need.
Enter the consumer number from your bill and check that the name and amount the portal shows match your bill before going further.
Pay by card, net banking or UPI and wait for the receipt page. Do not close the browser while the payment is being confirmed.
Download or note the transaction reference and keep it until the next bill shows the payment credited.
If money leaves your account but no receipt appears, do not pay again. Take the transaction reference to the department office — a double payment is refunded, but it takes weeks.
For an application rather than a payment, fill the form, upload Aadhaar and the address proof, and track it by the application number the portal gives you.
schemes.helpline: The office of the department concerned; the Deputy Commissioner's office at Port Blair for anything unresolved

schemes.title: Arunachal eServices — Certificates and Departmental Services
schemes.brief: Arunachal Pradesh's e-District system, where a resident applies for the income, Scheduled Tribe, permanent residence and other certificates without going to the district headquarters — which in this state can be a day's journey.
schemes.benefit: Income, Scheduled Tribe and permanent residence certificates applied for online
eligibility: Resident of Arunachal Pradesh, applying in the district where you live
A Scheduled Tribe certificate is issued only for the tribes notified for Arunachal Pradesh
A permanent residence certificate needs proof that the family has lived in the state for the qualifying period
An income certificate is valid for one year
documents: Father's Scheduled Tribe certificate, for a tribe certificate
School certificate or birth certificate for date of birth
Residence proof — electricity bill or a certificate from the Gaon Burah or the village authority

demoFields.label: Certificate applied for
demoFields.hint: Income, Scheduled Tribe, permanent residence, dependency or character certificate. Each has its own form and proof.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The certificate prints from this entry.

demoFields.label: Father's Name
demoFields.hint: For a tribe certificate this decides the case — tribe is traced through the father's family record.

demoFields.label: Tribe claimed
demoFields.hint: Pick from the notified list for Arunachal Pradesh. A tribe notified in another state does not qualify here.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Identity is confirmed on this and the OTP goes to the linked mobile.

demoFields.label: District / Circle / Village
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The Deputy Commissioner or the Extra Assistant Commissioner of this circle signs.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: For an income certificate, the household's total for the year from every source.

demoFields.label: Recommendation of the Gaon Burah or village authority
demoFields.value: Gaon Burah, Kheel village — signed and stamped
demoFields.hint: Most certificates here need the village authority's recommendation. Get it before you apply, not after.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the ready message come here by SMS.

demoSteps: Get the recommendation of your Gaon Burah or village authority first. Almost every certificate in Arunachal Pradesh needs it and the file stops without it.
Register on eservice.arunachal.gov.in with your mobile, confirm the OTP, and choose the certificate.
Fill the form and upload Aadhaar, the ration card, the father's tribe certificate where relevant, and the village recommendation.
Submit and note the application number. A Common Service Centre or the district e-District counter will file it for you if the network at home is poor.
The circle officer verifies and the Deputy Commissioner's office issues the certificate.
Download the signed certificate from the same login. Check the tribe name and your father's name before you rely on it, because a correction means applying again.
schemes.helpline: Your circle officer, or the Deputy Commissioner's office of your district
